_readme: Manual file. To feature a paying business set featured:true and featured_until:YYYY-MM-DD, then fill in note, tip, hours, price, best_for and whatsapp. Featured listings show first with a Featured label. Free listings show name, town and cuisine only. Expired featured_until dates drop back to free automatically.
